name: std::flat_set<Key,Compare,KeyContainer>::emplace
intro:
Inserts a new element into the container constructed in-place with the given args, if there is no element with the key in the container.

t

value_type

std::forward<Args>(args)...

t

auto it = ranges::upper_bound(c, t, compare);
c.insert(it, std::move(t));

This overload participates in overload resolution only if std::is_constructible_v<value_type, Args...> is true.

Careful use of emplace allows the new element to be constructed while avoiding unnecessary copy or move operations.

Information on iterator invalidation is copied from here

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
args

 -

 arguments to forward to the constructor of the element

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pair consisting of an iterator to the inserted element (or to the element that prevented the insertion) and a bool value set to true if and only if the insertion took place.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If an exception is thrown for any reason, this function has no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Logarithmic in the size of the container.
